semantic_review_result: No blocking mathematical or hypothesis mismatch found in the reviewed source snapshot.

checks.subject: Meaning of five percent
checks.finding: The uncertainty set is four fixed effective ODE coefficients k0,k10,k20,k21 in +/-5 percent intervals about (1,2,1,3). The actual negative diagonals are linked to those same rates; the zero entries remain zero. This does not certify independent five-percent uncertainties of physical flows and tank volumes.

checks.subject: Matrix directions and Metzler property
checks.finding: Actual M is [[-k0,0,0],[k10,-k10,0],[k20,k21,-(k20+k21)]]. All actual off-diagonal entries are nonnegative. To prove M<=H entrywise, positive off-diagonal entries use coefficient upper bounds, while each negative diagonal uses the corresponding coefficient lower bounds. In particular -(k20+k21)<=-19/5 follows from k20+k21>=19/5.

checks.subject: Input bound, actual positivity and initial state
checks.finding: The actual input at node 0 is k0*u, not u alone. k0>=0 and 0<=u<=1 give 0<=k0*u<=k0<=21/20. Other nodes have zero input. The comparison supplies actual nonnegative source and zero initial state to interval_upper, so actual x>=0 is derived inside the generic theorem. No unproved sign of x is used.

checks.subject: Explicit upper trajectory
checks.finding: r=19/20 and rho=21/19 make H diagonal (-r,-2r,-4r), input rho*r, and off-diagonal coefficients (2*rho*r,rho*r,3*rho*r). q=exp(-rt) has derivative -r*q. Writing A(q)=1/4-q/3+q^4/12 and B(q)=3/4-2q+3q^2/2-q^4/4 gives y2=rho^2*A+rho^3*B. The shortcut path has rho^2 and the two-link path rho^3. All three explicit derivatives satisfy dy/dt=Hy+g, with zero initial state.

checks.subject: Time and exact constant
checks.finding: checkTime=(20/19)*log(2)=(1/r)*log(2), so q(checkTime)=1/2. Then A=17/192, B=7/64 and y2=28077/109744. The exponent sign, r reciprocal and exact rational arithmetic are correct.

checks.subject: Claimed conclusion and scope
checks.finding: solution_below_upper bounds every given classical trajectory at every t>=0 by the explicit upperState(t), uniformly over admissible fixed rates and pointwise 0<=u<=1. outlet_robust_bound specializes to the single time checkTime, proving x2<=28077/109744<13/50. It does not prove x2<13/50 for all time or uniformly over the interval [0,checkTime].

exact_independent_checks.method: Built-in rational arithmetic; coefficient-by-coefficient polynomial ODE checks in q and affine matrix-bound sanity checks at all 16 rate-box corners.

nonblocking_scope_limits: H is an interval relaxation, not an admissible physical parameter choice: its row-1 off-diagonal 21/10 and diagonal -19/10 would require k10=21/10 and k10=19/10 simultaneously.
Consequently the bound is conservative and no claim of an attainable physical worst case or exact worst-case optimization follows.
The source proves a value below 0.26 at checkTime, not an all-time 0.26 bound. Monotonicity of upperState is not encoded in this module.
The four coefficients are fixed in time. Arbitrary time-varying rate uncertainty is not covered by this fixed-matrix application.

With independent +/-5 percent flow and volume errors, a flow/volume ratio can range from 19/21 to 21/19 times nominal, which extends outside the certified [19/20,21/20] rate interval. Such physical uncertainty is a different problem.
The comparison concerns supplied classical solutions. General existence or arbitrary measurable-input solution theorems are not proved here.
Interval-matrix certificates and this positive-system construction are classical methods, not novelty certification.
